Remark
[Weak hyperbolic time derivative] ↗ rem:motivation-weak-solution-parabolic 1. ch7:7.2.1-rem-1\group Hyperbolic PDE

Regard $u:[0,T]\to H_0^1(U)$ and $f:[0,T]\to L^2(U)$. Formal spatial integration by parts gives \[ \langle u'',v\rangle +B[u,v;t]=(f,v) \qquad (v\in H_0^1(U)). \tag {9} \] The equation implies \[ u_{tt}=g^0+\sum _{j=1}^n g^j_{x_j},\qquad g^0=f-\sum _{i=1}^n b^iu_{x_i}-cu,\quad g^j=\sum _{i=1}^n a^{ij}u_{x_i}, \] so $u''\in H^{-1}(U)$ is the natural weak time regularity.
